SRC-191:R001.text: APPEND -- route-budgeted protocol size; remove global markdown scarcity (high priority; resolves T-1639, unblocks T-1663)

SRC-191:R002.text: Do not solve this by increasing human_markdown_total by another arbitrary constant

SRC-191:R003.text: human_markdown_total stood at 334844 of 334848 and blocked protocol evolution though no route loads the whole protocol

SRC-191:R004.text: Replace the global human_markdown_total admission gate with route-aware protocol load budgets derived from existing SAIPEN registries

SRC-191:R005.text: Each canonical route reports mandatory files, mandatory bytes, optional references, applicable budget and verdict, measured mechanically

SRC-191:R006.text: Transitive mandatory references are counted whole; optional links, KNOWLEDGE trees, README links and archives are not counted unless a route loads them

SRC-191:R007.text: Route dependencies come from machine-readable declarations (registry), never from parsing prose

SRC-191:R008.text: human_markdown_total remains informational telemetry only and never blocks

SRC-191:R009.text: A per-document guard bounds any single protocol file, routed or not

SRC-191:R010.text: BOOT (cold start) is measured separately and unrelated documentation growth cannot raise its mandatory load

SRC-191:R011.text: Phase-local loading is preserved: a route budget counts only that route's documents; KNOWLEDGE and translations/public docs count only where a route loads them

SRC-191:R012.text: PRE-FIX control: a tiny valid clause in a document no route loads is red under the old aggregate cap while every route is within budget

SRC-191:R013.text: POST-FIX: the same clause is accepted when every route stays within budget

SRC-191:R014.text: ROUTE OVERFLOW control: mandatory BOOT or phase growth past its budget fails validation

SRC-191:R015.text: UNRELATED GROWTH control: the total rises, route loads stay unchanged, validation stays PASS

SRC-191:R016.text: TRANSITIVE control: a new mandatory dependency's bytes are included automatically

SRC-191:R017.text: OPTIONAL control: an optional reference does not inflate the mandatory load

SRC-191:R018.text: BOOT ISOLATION control: VERIFY/FUTURE growth leaves the BOOT load byte-identical
